workflow: Production cad-core creates an A3 paper layout and serializes a KDRAW1 container. A separate reader validates the magic, envelope, payload length, document SHA-256 and manifest checksum before reading document.json without calling deserializeKDraw.
result: The independent reader recovered the exact 420 x 297 mm paper, 10 mm margins, paper world 0,0 through 420,297, one viewport and one paper-space circle with stable handle 20 from the 1584-byte checksummed container.
